name: shree-ram-bharose-hindu-hotel
description: Hotel management PWA for Shree Ram Bharose Hindu Hotel (React + Firebase, custom auth)

scripts.install:all: npm i && npm --prefix functions i && npm --prefix web i
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix functions test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.test:emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-srbh --only firestore,storage "npm --prefix functions run test:integration"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-srbh --inspect-functions "npm --prefix web run e2e"
scripts.deploy: npm --prefix web run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore
